text: nice hell yeah haha [Image #3] uh so you knnow the texture slots u can put on faces. looks like its upside down haha can u turn it ride side up
resolution: User reported a texture-slot image rendering upside-down on a cooked-prop face (a picture frame). Resolved by the user rotating the image in the Studio — no code change. Noted the latent possibility that this is a systematic texture V-flip convention (the editor textureKey slot path flips V via geometryFor flipV / the compiled appendMeshPropNode flips when tex_key!=null, but the inline paint-atlas path does not), so if future slot images also arrive upside-down it would be a one-line flip fix rather than per-model Studio rotation. Left as-is per the user's choice; flagged for follow-up only if it recurs.
